_source: 93 real CAPEv2 2.5 detonations on the Cyclowareness host, 2026-07-27/28. Every signal is exactly what the analyzers produced, read back from stored job output rather than re-synthesised. 88 malware from MalwareBazaar and theZoo across 25 families; 5 signed, current releases downloaded from their vendors.
_guest: Windows 10 22H2 Pro 19045.3803, BIOS, network-isolated, INetSim sinkhole active.
_replay: Every analyzer the job ran is stored, not the dynamic tier alone, and the score is the one the full pipeline computed. The eleven-sample fixture replayed dynamic signals only and recomputed the score with ioc_total=0, which reproduced a verdict the product never reached - 57/88 where the product gets 74/88. A fixture that does not replay the pipeline cannot regression-test it.
_warning: Do NOT tune a threshold to make a named sample pass. Over-fitting to eleven samples is what produced the false-positive regression this corpus replaced. A sample that moves is a reason to re-read its evidence, not to move a number.
